drums.tags: Indie rock with a driving, rhythmic focus. The arrangement features a clean electric guitar playing a repetitive, syncopated two-note riff and a prominent electric bass that follows the kick drum pattern. The drum kit consists of a tight snare, a dry kick, and consistent eighth-note hi-hats. A subtle, sustained organ pad provides harmonic filling in the background. The tempo is 124 BPM in 4/4 time. The track is in the key of A major. The production is dry with minimal reverb, emphasizing the interlocking rhythmic parts.

A distorted electric guitar enters later, playing sustained power chords and melodic lead lines with moderate overdrive. The arrangement is built on a repetitive four-bar loop that evolves through the addition of instrumental layers. 110 BPM, E minor, 4/4 time.
